categories.main_business_segments: Changsha Jingjia Microelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the integrated circuit design sector, focusing on GPU chip development, graphical display control modules, small specialized radar systems, and chip products. The company’s core business includes high-reliability electronic products for graphical display control, specialized radar, and chip fields, with an emphasis on GPU design and applications expanding from graphics rendering to AI training, inference, and scientific computing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in GPU chip design using a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third-party manufacturers. It employs advanced technologies in system design, hardware, software, FPGA, thermal, mechanical, and electromagnetic compatibility design. The company also integrates microwave and signal processing technologies for radar products and develops high-performance GPU architectures supporting virtualization and cloud computing scenarios.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are concentrated in specialized markets such as aerospace and defense, with products also targeting broader general markets including automotive, marine, and cloud computing sectors. The company serves industries requiring high-reliability graphical display and radar solutions, as well as AI and scientific computing applications. Major customers include large state-owned enterprises and specialized industry clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and major facilities located in Changsha, Hunan Province. Its sales and operations are focused on the domestic market, serving Chinese customers and collaborating with domestic CPU, OS, and system manufacturers to build a local computing ecosystem.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jingjia Microelectronics operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on chip design and product development. It follows a fabless model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to external foundries and subcontractors, while maintaining control over design, quality, and testing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on continuous innovation in GPU technology, expanding from specialized to combined specialized and general-purpose markets, with a strong emphasis on AI applications. It pursues a rolling product development strategy ('pre-research, finalization, production'), invests heavily in R&D (over 60% of revenue), and collaborates with academic and industry partners to advance GPU architectures and computing ecosystems. It also invests in radar technology and system-level product development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-reliability electronic products, including GPU chips, graphical display modules, radar systems, and integrated computing modules. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and limited leasing activities. Sales are mostly direct to specialized customers, with some indirect sales in broader general markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jingjia Microelectronics is positioned as a leading domestic GPU design company in China, with significant technological advantages and a strong product portfolio. Its main international competitors include Intel, NVIDIA, and AMD in the GPU space, while domestically it competes with companies like China Shipbuilding Lingjiu Electronics. In radar, competitors include Beijing Institute of Technology LeiKe Electronics. The company emphasizes its technological leadership and comprehensive lifecycle management as competitive strengths.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 466 million, a 34.62% decrease from 2023, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 165 million. Despite revenue decline, total assets grew by over 80% to RMB 7.56 billion, largely due to a significant capital raise of RMB 3.83 billion through a private placement. R&D investment remains high at over RMB 280 million, accounting for 60.18% of revenue. The company is in a growth and investment phase, focusing on long-term strategic development despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its deep expertise in GPU chip design with full lifecycle management, proprietary GPU architectures, and a broad product range extending from graphical rendering to AI computing. It offers high-reliability, customized solutions for specialized markets such as aerospace and defense, while expanding into general-purpose and AI markets. Its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and strategic collaborations underpin its competitive moat and ability to meet diverse customer needs with innovative, high-performance products.
